body_text:
Back to Blog

 Door County Kayak and Paddle boards for Sale

What is the best kayak to buy?
With over 15 years of kayaking with beginners, we have honed in on what most people should be paddling.

For most people, we highly recommend buying a sit on top kayak.

You don’t have to learn and keep up to date on as many lessons

Partner rescues

Solo Rescues

You don’t have to have any gear to do rescues

Paddle float

Bilge Pump

Skirt

With a sit-on-top kayak, if it flips over, you can just flip it back over and climb back on.

Why the perception rambler 13.5 is better than the Ocean Kayak…

Quality, durability, and tracking.  We have tried both of these kayaks for many years and the perception rambler 13.5 stands out as a better more versatile kayak.

The perception rambler 13.5 is the best kayak for the money

Do you need to register a kayak?
In the state of wisconsin, you do not need to register your kayak, we do recommend writing on it contact information.  This helps the coast guard contact you if it floats away to make sure they don’t need to look for anyone.

How much does a kayak cost?

We sell our used kayaks at the end of the season for $250 and the beginning of the season for $350

Do kayaks tip over easily?
Sit on top kayak don’t tip over easily.

Buy one now, they hold their value and are a great addition to the cabin.

Give us a call/txt or email [email protected] to take a look at the kayaks we have for sale. (920) 868-1400
